text.description_html:
Metal Sub-Rose Assembly for Omnia Brass Knobsets

Omnia metal sub-rose assembly feature self-aligning thru-bolts and fits a standard 2-1/8" bore hole. Knob strength spring assisted inside and outside, for Door Knobs only (Not for use with Door Levers). For use with passage and privacy functions. Has a 7mm hub that fits 7mm Passage Spindle and 7mm Privacy Spindle.

The new metal sub-rose assembly replaces all older Nylon sub-rose cassettes. For use with Omnia Brass Knobsets only.

Specifications for Omnia 982/LP-K Metal Sub-Rose Cassette

  • Diameter: 2-7/16"
  • Projection: 3/8"
  • Fits standard 2-1/8" Bore Hole
  • 7mm Square Hub (for 7mm Square Spindle)

Sold Individually
